answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the dawn is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The saffron holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
